instruction: When I double-click video files, VLC keeps opening multiple instances. Could you help me configure VLC to use only one instance and enqueue new files in the existing player instead of opening multiple windows?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling single instance mode in VLC. The evaluator checks the one-instance-when-started-from-file setting in VLC config file. Expected value is 1 (enabled). Uses existing check_one_instance_when_started_from_file metric function.
metadata.verification: Checked existing VLC metric functions. check_one_instance_when_started_from_file reads vlcrc file and verifies one-instance-when-started-from-file=1. Default is 1 (already enabled), but task simulates changing it.
